faqs.q: How much does Valant EHR cost?
faqs.a: Valant EHR pricing ranges from $100-300/provider/month depending on modules selected. Standard plans (~$100-150/mo) include core EHR and documentation. Professional plans (~$150-225/mo) add billing and telehealth. Enterprise plans (~$225-300/mo) include AI documentation and advanced analytics. Implementation is typically included.

Yes, Valant is specifically designed for behavioral health with psychiatry-specific features: EPCS for controlled substance prescribing, PDMP integration, medication management workflows, outcome tracking with PHQ-9/GAD-7, and psychiatric note templates. 98% of customers are small practices.

Yes, Valant includes AI-assisted documentation features that help generate clinical notes and treatment plans. However, for advanced AI scribing capabilities, standalone AI scribes like Freed ($99/mo) or Heidi Health offer more sophisticated ambient dictation.

faqs.q: What are alternatives to Valant EHR?
faqs.a: For solo/small practices: TherapyNotes ($49/mo) or SimplePractice ($59/mo) offer simpler, lower-cost options. For medium practices: TheraNest or Jane App. For large behavioral health organizations: Netsmart myEvolv or Qualifacts CareLogic. For psychiatry with enterprise needs: Kipu or Oracle Health.

Yes, Valant includes integrated telehealth with Zoom-based video sessions. The patient portal allows clients to join sessions directly without separate software. Telehealth is included in Professional and Enterprise plans.
